analysis.company_summary: European freight forwarder building a real-time digital platform connecting shippers and carriers.

headline: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior software engineer with 7 years of experience building backend services in Python, most recently a shipment-tracking platform in logistics. Experienced with Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD on AWS, event-driven integrations with Apache Kafka, and mentoring junior developers. AWS Certified Developer.

bullets.text: Designed and built a Python/FastAPI shipment-tracking platform with REST APIs, used by 40 enterprise customers and handling 2 million events per day.
Built event-driven carrier integrations using Apache Kafka.
Migrated 12 services from virtual machines to Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS, reducing infrastructure cost by 30%.
Introduced CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, cutting release time from one day to 20 minutes.
Mentored 4 junior developers and led weekly code reviews.
Raised automated test coverage of the main product from 35% to 80% using pytest and Jest.
Developed customer web applications with React and TypeScript for 15+ clients.
Automated recurring IT administration tasks with Python scripts.

requirement_matches.requirement: 5+ years backend development with Python or Go

cover_letter_hooks: Built a shipment-tracking platform handling 2 million events per day - directly relevant to NordFreight's visibility platform.
